findings.finding: encode requires only x, observed and metadata. It constructs only the saved shared or CF backbone on the meta device, loads exact backbone tensors, freezes parameters and reasserts eval mode. It creates no head or optimizer and does not reset RNG, change determinism policy or invoke training admission/cache setup.

Loading uses weights_only=True and map_location='cpu'. Artifact kind, explicit dimensions, supported history, complete scaler state, float32 precision, exact tensor keys/shapes/dtypes and finiteness are checked. Downstream-supervised artifact kinds are explicitly rejected.

Input validation enforces exact saved history, four ordered frequencies, Boolean masks, a complete primary prefix, finite observed values and metadata, nominal 60-minute interval, integrated-product geometry, increasing nonnegative bounds, orientation0=unknown, Boolean known flags and relative offset0. Native bounds are passed unchanged; dB normalization has no depth scaling. Masked secondary fills, including NaN/Inf, do not affect features.

Method labels distinguish shared/masked/CF SSL, permuted pairing control, direct supervised features and random untrained control. CF selected EMA tensors and BatchNorm buffers remain frozen in eval mode. Historical source bindings are defensive-copy provenance and are never opened or dynamically executed.

The completed shared selected artifact matches the original inference and run config, bindings, scalers and all 58 encoder tensor keys. CPU loading produced only the 2,424,448-parameter backbone with latent64/history96, preserved Torch RNG and left CUDA uninitialized. The absent selected_pretrain_step field remains absent; the original inference/run record retains step4500.

The API explicitly states that source-date contiguity and association with issuance cutoff remain caller responsibilities. Three timestamp-free arrays cannot verify temporal provenance or the truth of caller-supplied geometry. No timestamp-verification or scientific-value claim is introduced.

executed_checks.result: 81 synthetic CPU tests passed in 21.77 seconds with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, -B, -s and cacheprovider disabled. BytesIO codecs; no optimizer, GPU or real acoustic input. No denial occurred.

command.python_source:
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from marine_echo.inference.native_encoder import NativeAcousticEncoder
p=Path('outputs/native_acoustic_ssl_v1/shared_ssl_seed7_h96_cuda0')
s=torch.load(p/'selected_encoder.pt',weights_only=True,map_location='cpu')
i=torch.load(p/'inference.pt',weights_only=True,map_location='cpu')
r=json.loads((p/'run.json').read_text())
assert s['kind']=='native_ssl_selected_encoder_v1' and i['kind']=='native_ssl_weights_only_inference_v1'
assert s['config']==i['config']==r['config']
assert s['bindings']==i['bindings']==r['bindings']
assert s['scalers']==i['scalers']==json.loads((p/'scalers.json').read_text())
e={k.removeprefix('encoder.'):v for k,v in i['model'].items() if k.startswith('encoder.')}
assert set(e)==set(s['encoder']) and all(torch.equal(v,e[k]) for k,v in s['encoder'].items())
assert 'selected_pretrain_step' not in s and i['selected_pretrain_step']==r['selected_pretrain_step']==4500
before=torch.get_rng_state().clone()
a=NativeAcousticEncoder(p/'selected_encoder.pt',device='cpu')
assert torch.equal(before,torch.get_rng_state())
assert all(not v.requires_grad and v.grad is None for v in a.encoder.parameters())
assert all(not m.training for m in a.encoder.modules())
assert all(torch.equal(v,a.encoder.state_dict()[k]) for k,v in s['encoder'].items())
print(json.dumps({'artifact_hashes':{n:hashlib.file_digest(open(p/n,'rb'),'sha256').hexdigest() for n in ['selected_encoder.pt','inference.pt','run.json','scalers.json']},'kind':s['kind'],'method':a.method,'training_kind':a.training_kind,'history':a.config.history,'embedding_dimension':a.embedding_dimension,'encoder_parameters':sum(v.numel() for v in a.encoder.parameters()),'tensor_keys':len(e),'source_binding_count':len(a.source_bindings),'optional_step_in_selected':a.selected_pretrain_step,'parent_inference_selected_step':i['selected_pretrain_step'],'cpu_frozen_backbone_loaded_without_rng_change':True,'cuda_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized(),'encode_real_data':'NOT_RUN'}))
